description: ISS pass predictions — $0.01 USDC on Base via x402. Two-phase flow: a first call with lat/lon (no 'payment') returns the live payment requirements (payTo, amount, networks); after payment from the caller's own wallet, a second call with 'payment' set to the base64 x402 payload returns the passes in the tool result. Computed from public CelesTrak orbital data. This tool never pays and never touches private keys. Example: {lat:30.5651, lon:-97.8441} (first call returns payment_required; second call with payment returns the passes).

payment.description: Base64-encoded x402 v1 payment payload (the signed ExactEvmPayload JSON). Absent on the first call, which receives the payment requirements; present on the follow-up call, after signing in the caller's own wallet / x402 client. The server only forwards it to the rail — it never signs, never holds funds, never touches private keys.

name: qm_data_iss_pass
